Obviously AI

Obviously AI provides no-code predictive analytics and AI-agent workflows for teams that want to build models and predictions without a traditional data-science stack.

What is Obviously AI?

Obviously AI is a no-code analytics and machine-learning platform built for business teams that want predictions without manually coding models. The platform supports common predictive tasks such as classification, regression, time-series work and clustering, while also exposing REST APIs and paid service tiers for larger datasets and supported use cases.

Best for: Business teams and analysts that need quick predictive models without maintaining their own machine-learning development environment.

Main features

  • No-code predictive modeling
  • Classification and regression
  • Time-series analysis
  • Clustering
  • AI agents and custom LLM workflows
  • REST API
  • Automation and RPA capabilities

Use cases

  • Predict churn or conversion likelihood
  • Forecast business metrics
  • Segment customers or records
  • Build predictive scoring workflows
  • Expose predictions to another application through REST APIs

Who is it for?

  • business analysts
  • operations teams
  • growth teams
  • small data teams
  • non-technical decision makers

Pricing and plans

freemium subscription / custom paid pricing

Check official pricing ↗

Advantages

  • Free plan gives users a way to test predictive modeling
  • Supports several common prediction types without requiring code
  • REST API is explicitly included in the platform offering

Limitations

  • Paid-plan prices are not publicly listed on the checked pricing page
  • The free tier is CSV-focused and has file/row limits
  • Prediction allowances, use-case counts and maximum dataset sizes vary by tier

Frequently asked questions

Does Obviously AI have a free plan?

Yes. The current pricing page lists a Free tier with a defined prediction allowance, one seat and limits on file size and rows.

Which predictive tasks does the free tier cover?

The pricing page lists classification, regression, time-series and clustering among the supported modeling types.

Can predictions be integrated into another application?

Yes. Obviously AI lists REST APIs as part of the product, enabling programmatic use of supported workflows.
